A few things to know before you start.

Is this connected to an AI or cloud service?

No. This is a reusable launch template with a browser-only demo. A real product needs its own backend and service integrations.

Can I use this for my own project?

Yes. Replace the copy, project links, examples and brand colors. The sample roadmap is not a release commitment.

How do I contribute to a real project?

Read the README, license and CONTRIBUTING first, then start with documentation or a good first issue.Browse curated resources。
